## Finding the angle between vectors {#iv6-angle-formula .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson .angles-lesson .a-formula}

For two non-zero vectors in 2D or 3D:

$$
\cos\theta=\frac{\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}}{|\underset{\sim}{a}||\underset{\sim}{b}|}
$$

```{=html}
<div class="a-syllabus-note"><p>The syllabus specifies that the angle between vectors is stated in the range</p><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="0^\circ\leq\theta\leq180^\circ"></span>.</div></div>
```
